description:
Resolve a platform-policy dead-end with a structured plan decision.

    ``decision`` is one of ``reuse_existing_evidence``, ``split_task``,
    ``raise_project_cap``, ``remove_scenario``, or
    ``correct_evidence_selector``. ``raise_project_cap`` also requires
    ``project_cap`` (6..32). The decision becomes a new task-plan section; the
    same task lineage is requeued before the escalation resolves.

    ``correct_evidence_selector`` (web_app tasks, active workspace owner only;
    a workspace key or a non-owner gets ``owner_decision_required``) fixes a
    frozen ``ready_selector`` no scenario can prove, such as an interaction
    criterion frozen with the selector its static sibling proves at route
    load. ``selector_corrections`` maps each acceptance-criterion id (the
    ``criterion_id`` of a list_escalations ``evidence_selector_cells`` entry)
    to ``{"expected_ready_selector": <the frozen value>, "ready_selector":
    <replacement>}`` (at most 10). Only those selectors change; a stale
    expected value, an invalid selector, a cell left with two selectors, or an
    interaction criterion that would still share a static sibling's selector
    changes nothing. The old and new specs are audited.

    On a project that runs the ui-review evidence lifecycle (``ui-review.json``
    is a retained evidence catalog), ``raise_project_cap`` changes the
    per-run capture budget -- how many scenarios one capture run holds -- not
    catalog capacity: the catalog has no scenario limit, so no decision is
    needed to make room in it.

    On a ``web_app`` task, ``reuse_existing_evidence`` also repairs a frozen
    theme-only collision in the same transaction: criteria whose evidence specs
    differ only by a light/dark variant token (for example
    ``setup-timeline-light`` and ``setup-timeline-dark``) are refrozen to one
    shared cell that lists the required ``themes``, the old and new specs are
    audited, and the plan tells the worker to cover that cell with one
    scenario. Criteria on one route, state and variant that name different
    ready selectors are likewise refrozen to one selector. Every criterion
    keeps its row and alias; unrelated specs are not changed.
name: resolve_platform_policy_conflict
title: Resolve Platform Policy Conflict
